sheet_prompts.a:
STYLE REFERENCE (attached image): The attached image is an already-approved unit from the SAME game (horseman). Match ONLY its hand-painted 2D art style, bold dark ink outline weight, flat cel shading with soft highlights, earthy colour richness, silhouette readability at 48 pixels, flat #FF00FF magenta background, and saturated pure-red (#E01010) team-colour convention. DO NOT copy that character, silhouette, outfit, weapon, mount, or vehicle — draw a completely different unit matching the specification below.

ERA / VISUAL THEME: ancient war elephant with a howdah, mahout and archer crew

I am making art for ONE unit in a family-friendly historical strategy game. Draw ONE image: the master design of this unit.
Every later image of this unit will be drawn from it, and the game will animate this drawing by cutting it into parts, so it
must follow the pose rules exactly.

THE UNIT: War Elephant. a large grey-skinned war elephant in a hand-painted historical strategy style, with curved ivory tusks fitted with bronze caps, a bronze-studded leather head guard, a red cloth blanket over its back and a wooden howdah tower on top with a mahout driving at the neck and an archer standing in the howdah holding a recurve bow upright in his left hand with the bowstring toward him, and a nocked arrow resting on the string; the elephant stands in side view facing right

STYLE: clean hand-painted 2D game art, bold dark outline, flat cel shading with soft highlights, earthy saturated palette,
friendly readable proportions that still read when the unit is 48 pixels tall. No photorealism, no 3D-render look, no pixel art.

VIEW: strict side view, facing RIGHT. The whole unit is inside the image with empty space of about a tenth of the image on
every side. No ground, floor, shadow, scenery, text, labels, border or effects.

BACKGROUND: one completely flat, uniform solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) background filling the entire image behind the unit. NO transparency checkerboard, NO grey-and-white grid, NO gradient, NO drop shadow, NO ambient glow, NO vignette, NO soft semi-transparent edges. Every outline, smoke puff, flame, dust cloud, or effect must be 100% solid, opaque, and hard-edged with a clean dark ink outline against the #FF00FF magenta so nothing blends into purple. Put nothing magenta, pink, or purple anywhere on the unit.

TEAM COLOUR: paint the red blanket under the howdah and the howdah banner saturated pure red (#E01010). That is the ONLY red or red-orange anywhere in the image.
Everything else (the animal's coat, mane and hooves, skin, leather, wood, metal) is brown, tan, grey, black, white, bronze or dull dark maroon. The game recolours that red to
each player's colour, so any other red would change colour too.

POSE FOR ANIMATION (the most important part):
- The animal stands square on one ground line: all four legs straight and vertical, every hoof flat, and a clear gap between
  each pair of neighbouring legs. Seen from the side the four legs read as four separate posts; no leg overlaps another.
- The tail hangs free, ends well above the hooves and does not touch the hind legs. The head is up, the neck arched.
- The elephant has a mid grey skin with no red or brown tones, so it does not trigger the red team-colour key.
- The rider sits upright. His feet, weapon, saddle cloth and any fringe all stay above the animal's knees.
- The archer stands in the howdah holding the bow upright and vertical in his left hand, the limbs curving forward, with an arrow nocked on the string and pointing forward and slightly up. The bow is never pointed down.

Generate the image now with crisp opaque edges on flat solid #FF00FF magenta.

REQUIRED CORRECTIONS FROM PREVIOUS ATTEMPT (fix every item):
- The rig could not separate all four legs below the belly. Draw the animal standing square with FOUR separate vertical legs and visible #FF00FF magenta gaps between every pair of neighbouring legs from hoof to belly; keep the tail well above the hooves.
sheet_prompts.b:

The attached image is the APPROVED MASTER design of this unit. It is the sole authoritative reference.

ERA / VISUAL THEME: ancient war elephant with a howdah, mahout and archer crew

WHAT TO DRAW:
DAMAGE (4 frames, a grid of 2 by 2): the master's standing pose four times, rider and animal progressively hurt. Keep the
   animal's four legs EXACTLY where they are in the master in all four frames (the game builds the walk from each of these
   drawings). In every frame the four legs are four separate posts, straight and vertical, every hoof flat on one ground
   line, with a visible gap of empty background between each pair of neighbouring legs from hoof to belly; no hoof touches
   another, and mud, bandages and tears never join two legs. The tail ends well above the hooves. Keep the same headgear in
   all four frames (frame 3 may dent it) and the weapon whole in frames 1 to 3 (frame 4 may break it, still held).
   (1) healthy, identical to the master; (2) light: mud on the animal's legs and belly, a slash across the rider's
   garment, a scuffed saddle cloth; (3) serious: torn saddle cloth and garment, a scuffed blanket, scratched head guard and a few arrows stuck in the howdah, a few dark-maroon stains,
   the animal's head lowered a little; (4) critical: bandages on the rider, a torn and dirty saddle cloth,
   a torn blanket, a cracked head guard, a splintered howdah and a broken bow, the animal's head and neck drooping, the rider slumped in the saddle.

MANDATORY RULES FOR THIS SHEET:
- Authoritative reference: match the attached master image EXACTLY (the same elephant, tusk caps, head guard, howdah, mahout, archer and red blanket). Same art style, bold dark outline, flat cel shading, palette, lighting, proportions, headgear, face, and held items in every frame. Do not redesign anything.
- Strict side view facing RIGHT, identical scale across every frame. Do NOT zoom in on a crouching, kneeling, or fallen pose.
- Leave clear empty #FF00FF magenta space (at least 20% of a figure width) between every pair of neighbouring figures and around all four outer edges of the image. No figure touches another figure or the image border.
- Nothing detached from a figure: no floating arrows, bullets, sparks, dust clouds, debris, motion arcs, or disconnected smoke puffs. Every weapon, shield, flame, or smoke wisp stays physically connected to the figure.
- BACKGROUND: one completely flat, uniform solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) background filling the entire image behind the unit. NO transparency checkerboard, NO grey-and-white grid, NO gradient, NO drop shadow, NO ambient glow, NO vignette, NO soft semi-transparent edges. Every outline, smoke puff, flame, dust cloud, or effect must be 100% solid, opaque, and hard-edged with a clean dark ink outline against the #FF00FF magenta so nothing blends into purple. Put nothing magenta, pink, or purple anywhere on the unit.
- Paint the red blanket under the howdah and the howdah banner saturated pure red (#E01010), exactly as in the master; it is the ONLY bright red anywhere in the image. Wounds, stains, rust, and fire are dark maroon, brown, grey, yellow-orange, or black — never bright red. Family-friendly, no blood and no gore.
- No text, labels, numbers, boxes, borders, grid lines, ground planes, or shadows.
- Do NOT draw a walk, run, gallop, rolling, or flying cycle; the game animates movement itself.
- CRITICAL FOR WALK RIGGING: keep every leg and foot/hoof in the EXACT position of the master with a clear solid #FF00FF magenta gap between every pair of legs in ALL 4 frames. Mud, bandages, weapons, or torn cloth must never bridge or touch across the leg gap.

REQUIRED CORRECTIONS FROM PREVIOUS ATTEMPT (fix every item):
